reason: After the private upstream observation repair, original Chrome focus-return10 receives the actual current surrounding snapshot and ManualToggleV3 delegates exact manual replay. During the authenticated same-field factory layout handoff the actual target snapshot arrives before activation publication. Installation drops the transferred exact source receipt because it previously handled only an absent target callback. UnknownStart correctly remains unknown, but the existing V4 lease becomes passive and refuses replay. Content hints stay public64; the daemon retention-policy message is a consequence of passive refusal, not evidence of changed privacy.
decision: At installation of an already authenticated same-field Transfer grant, bind its unexpired exact manual source to an actual current target observation using the existing reducer publish_exact_manual_snapshot contract. Require the same owned tail and epoch, collapsed caret at text end, supported surrounding text, non-sensitive content, and exact equality of the complete observed external prefix. Preserve the source expiry. When no target callback exists retain the existing inherited receipt path. A later callback still invalidates either proof, even if identical. Keep UnknownStart/suffix0, source-free admission, field revocation, replay lease, verifier and output routes unchanged.
